title: Discharge Summary - Riverside General Hospital
text:
RIVERSIDE GENERAL HOSPITAL
DISCHARGE SUMMARY

Patient: Jane D.
DOB: 04/22/1968
Admit Date: 05/10/2024
Discharge Date: 05/14/2024
Attending: Dr. M. Reyes, MD

BLOOD TYPE: A positive

PRINCIPAL DIAGNOSIS:
1. Acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)

SECONDARY DIAGNOSES:
2. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, uncontrolled
3. Essential Hypertension

PROCEDURES PERFORMED:
- Bronchoscopy with bronchoalveolar lavage (05/11/2024)

HOSPITAL COURSE:
Patient presented with 3-day history of worsening dyspnea and productive cough. Chest X-ray confirmed hyperinflation consistent with COPD exacerbation. Bronchoscopy performed on 05/11/2024 was unremarkable for malignancy. Blood glucose on admission was 312 mg/dL; insulin sliding scale initiated and diabetes medications adjusted.

DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS:
1. Tiotropium bromide 18 mcg inhaled once daily
2. Metformin 1000mg PO BID (increased from 500mg)
3. Lisinopril 10mg PO daily

ALLERGIES:
- Penicillin: hives, severity moderate
- Sulfa drugs: rash, severity low

FOLLOW-UP:
Primary care in 1 week. Pulmonology in 4 weeks.
